verdict.rationale: Skyfire has no built-in natural-language console. Its first-party MCP server lets an AI agent discover sellers, create kya/pay/kya-pay tokens and "orchestrate agent commerce workflows," so a user can drive part of the product through an MCP-capable assistant. The documented tool surface is narrow: only find-sellers and three token-creation tools. Charging, introspection, wallet, service and agent management stay API- or dashboard-only. Missing for 10: a native natural-language interface, NL/MCP coverage of charging, wallet and seller-service management, and hands-on corroboration of NL-driven workflows.
